headline: Comilla schoolgirl murder: Accused CNG driver taken to court for confession
summary: A CNG driver accused of raping and killing a Class 7 student in Comilla has been produced before a court for a confessional statement.
details: An auto-rickshaw driver named Suman was produced before the Comilla Senior Judicial Magistrate's court on Saturday for a confessional statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
caption:
A CNG driver accused of raping and killing a Class 7 student in Comilla has been taken to court for his confession.

An auto-rickshaw driver named Suman was produced before the Comilla Senior Judicial Magistrate's court on Saturday for a confessional statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

headline_marked: Biman flight from Cox's Bazar [[lands safely in Dhaka after technical delay]]
headline: Biman flight from Cox's Bazar lands safely in Dhaka after technical delay
summary: Flight BG436 experienced operational and technical issues, prompting a safe landing at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 3:10pm today.
details: A Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight from Cox’s Bazar landed safely at Dhaka's Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 3:10pm today after being delayed due to operational and technical issues.
All passengers and crew members aboard flight BG436 were safe, according to the airline.
Biman attributed the delay to “unavoidable operational and technical circumstances,” though they did not specify the exact nature of the problems.

The airline stated that the landing was successful thanks to the immediate guidance of Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat, and the efforts of pilots, engineers, and airport authorities.
This incident follows a similar occurrence in May last year, when another BG436 flight on the same route lost a wheel from its left main landing gear shortly after takeoff from Cox’s Bazar.
Additionally, in August this year, a Biman flight from Toronto to Dhaka was delayed for nearly 40 hours in Rome due to a technical fault.
caption:
A Biman flight from Cox's Bazar faced technical issues and was delayed before landing safely in Dhaka today.

A Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight from Cox’s Bazar landed safely at Dhaka's Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 3:10pm today after being delayed due to operational and technical issues.

All passengers and crew members aboard flight BG436 were safe, according to the airline.

Biman attributed the delay to “unavoidable operational and technical circumstances,” though they did not specify the exact nature of the problems.

The airline stated that the landing was successful thanks to the immediate guidance of Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat, and the efforts of pilots, engineers, and airport authorities.

This incident follows a similar occurrence in May last year, when another BG436 flight on the same route lost a wheel from its left main landing gear shortly after takeoff from Cox’s Bazar.

Additionally, in August this year, a Biman flight from Toronto to Dhaka was delayed for nearly 40 hours in Rome due to a technical fault.
